context: A workplace meeting on handling client data
purpose: Teach: 扱っ/フォーム/有する/見出し/果たす/コレクション/予備/ゼミ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今日の会議では、お客様データをどう扱っていくかを話し合いたい。
lines.en: In today's meeting, I want to discuss how we should handle customer data going forward.
lines.style: Calm, measured opening from a senior office worker setting the agenda.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、まず申込フォームの見直しから始めたほうがいいと思います。
lines.en: Yes, I think we should start by reviewing the application form first.
lines.style: Polite, businesslike suggestion from a thoughtful female colleague.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 確かに。資料の見出しを見ても、項目が多すぎる印象がある。
lines.en: True. Even looking at the document's headings, the items feel excessive.
lines.style: Reflective agreement, slightly critical tone of a male manager.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 個人情報を扱う以上、会社として重い責任を有することになりますよね。
lines.en: Since we handle personal information, the company ends up bearing serious responsibility, doesn't it.
lines.style: Earnest, formal expression from a conscientious female employee.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: その通りだ。担当者として果たすべき役割をきちんと整理しよう。
lines.en: Exactly. Let's properly organize the roles we must fulfill as those in charge.
lines.style: Affirming, leadership-toned reply from an experienced male coworker.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: それから、過去の顧客データのコレクションも一度見直す必要がありますね。
lines.en: Also, we'll need to review our past collection of customer data at some point.
lines.style: Practical, forward-looking comment from a detail-oriented woman.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 予備のサーバーにバックアップを取ってから作業に入ろう。
lines.en: Let's take a backup on the spare server before starting the work.
lines.style: Cautious, procedural instruction from a careful male supervisor.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解です。来週の社内ゼミでも、この方針を共有しておきましょうか。
lines.en: Understood. Shall we share this policy at next week's in-house study session as well?
lines.style: Cooperative, proactive suggestion from a competent female colleague.
